Ask the Studio
How do I choose a fragrance?+

Start with your favorite fragrance family. Our Scent Guide introduces floral, fresh, woody, citrus and amber notes. If you would like help, send us an inquiry.

What sizes are shown in the collection?+

The catalog features 50 mL bottles. Each listing shows its concentration and sample price.

Can I ask about a fragrance gift?+

Yes. Tell us who the gift is for and a little about their preferences using the single inquiry form.

How can I ask about delivery?+

Include your city or province in your message. The studio can confirm available delivery options when the business is connected for a real launch.

How should I store perfume?+

Keep the bottle closed and away from direct sunlight or unnecessary heat. Follow any care guidance supplied with your fragrance.

Can I buy directly through this website?+

This website is a fragrance catalog. Use the inquiry form to ask about a scent, availability or gifting.
